<?php

/* Functions shared by the Forecasting module pages.

Conventions
 - A "series" is a list of monthly quantities, oldest first, no gaps. The last element is the most recent history month.
 - A period is identified by the first day of its month (Y-m-01).
 - A location code of '' means "all locations combined".
 - The effective quantity of a forecast period is the revised quantity when there is one (NULL means none, 0 is a valid
   revision), otherwise the calculated quantity. Everything that reads forecast quantities uses ForecastEffectiveSQL().
 - Values passed to these functions are raw values (not already escaped for SQL), see ForecastInput() for posted data.
 - Sales history comes from stockmoves, see ForecastExtractHistory().
*/

define('FORECAST_DEMAND_TYPE', 'FC');

/* Raw value of a posted/requested field. session.php escapes and html-encodes every $_POST/$_GET value, the functions
here escape for themselves so they need the original text */
function ForecastInput($Value) {
	return html_entity_decode(stripslashes($Value), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Dates
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

function ForecastMonthStart($Date) {
	return date('Y-m-01', strtotime($Date));
}

function ForecastAddMonths($Date, $Months) {
	$DateTime = new DateTime(substr($Date, 0, 7) . '-01');
	$DateTime->modify(($Months >= 0 ? '+' : '') . (int) $Months . ' month');
	return $DateTime->format('Y-m-d');
}

/* number of months from $From to $To, both months included */
function ForecastMonthsBetween($From, $To) {
	$FromParts = explode('-', $From);
	$ToParts = explode('-', $To);
	return (($ToParts[0] - $FromParts[0]) * 12) + ($ToParts[1] - $FromParts[1]) + 1;
}

function ForecastMonthLabel($Date) {
	return MonthAndYearFromSQLDate($Date, true);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Methods and parameters
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

function ForecastMethods() {
	return array(
		1 => __('Percent over last year'),
		2 => __('Calculated percent over last year'),
		3 => __('Last year to this year'),
		4 => __('Moving average'),
		5 => __('Linear approximation'),
		6 => __('Least squares regression'),
		7 => __('Second degree approximation'),
		8 => __('Flexible method'),
		9 => __('Weighted moving average'),
		10 => __('Simple exponential smoothing'),
		11 => __("Holt's double exponential smoothing"),
		12 => __('Holt-Winters'),
	);
}

function ForecastMethodName($Method) {
	$Methods = ForecastMethods();
	return $Methods[(int) $Method] ?? __('Unknown');
}

function ForecastDefaultParameters() {
	return array(
		'alpha' => 0.3,
		'beta' => 0.1,
		'gamma' => 0.1,
		'seasonlength' => 12,
		'maperiods' => 3,
		'holdoutmonths' => 6,
		'defaulthorizon' => 12,
		'percent' => 10,
		'linearspan' => 5,
		'wmaweights' => '40,30,20,10',
		'flexweights' => '25,15,10,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,50',
		'lowaccuracy' => 70,
		'variancepct' => 25,
	);
}

/* The company wide defaults: what is in forecastparameters over the built in values */
function ForecastGetParameters() {
	$Parameters = ForecastDefaultParameters();
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT paramname, paramvalue FROM forecastparameters");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		if (array_key_exists($MyRow['paramname'], $Parameters)) {
			$Parameters[$MyRow['paramname']] = $MyRow['paramvalue'];
		}
	}
	return ForecastCleanParameters($Parameters);
}

function ForecastCleanParameters($Parameters) {
	foreach (array('alpha', 'beta', 'gamma', 'percent', 'lowaccuracy', 'variancepct') as $Key) {
		$Parameters[$Key] = (float) $Parameters[$Key];
	}
	foreach (array('seasonlength', 'maperiods', 'holdoutmonths', 'defaulthorizon', 'linearspan') as $Key) {
		$Parameters[$Key] = (int) $Parameters[$Key];
	}
	foreach (array('wmaweights', 'flexweights') as $Key) {
		$Parameters[$Key] = trim($Parameters[$Key]);
	}
	return $Parameters;
}

function ForecastSaveParameters($Parameters) {
	foreach ($Parameters as $Name => $Value) {
		DB_query("REPLACE INTO forecastparameters (paramname, paramvalue)
					VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($Name) . "', '" . DB_escape_string($Value) . "')");
	}
}

/* "40,30,20,10" -> array(0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1) as fractions, or null when it is not a list of numbers >= 0.
   The weights are percentages, they are entered most recent period first */
function ForecastParseWeights($WeightString, $MaxCount = 12) {
	$Parts = array_filter(array_map('trim', explode(',', $WeightString)), function ($Part) {
		return $Part !== '';
	});
	if (count($Parts) == 0 or count($Parts) > $MaxCount) {
		return null;
	}
	$Weights = array();
	foreach ($Parts as $Part) {
		if (!is_numeric($Part) or $Part < 0) {
			return null;
		}
		$Weights[] = $Part / 100;
	}
	if (array_sum($Weights) <= 0) {
		return null;
	}
	return $Weights;
}

/* Check a full parameter set. Returns a list of messages, empty when all is well */
function ForecastValidateParameters($Parameters) {
	$Errors = array();
	if ($Parameters['alpha'] < 0.1 or $Parameters['alpha'] > 0.9) {
		$Errors[] = __('Alpha must be between 0.1 and 0.9');
	}
	if ($Parameters['beta'] <= 0 or $Parameters['beta'] >= 1) {
		$Errors[] = __('Beta must be greater than 0 and less than 1');
	}
	if ($Parameters['gamma'] <= 0 or $Parameters['gamma'] >= 1) {
		$Errors[] = __('Gamma must be greater than 0 and less than 1');
	}
	if ($Parameters['seasonlength'] < 2 or $Parameters['seasonlength'] > 12) {
		$Errors[] = __('The season length must be between 2 and 12 months');
	}
	if ($Parameters['maperiods'] < 2 or $Parameters['maperiods'] > 12) {
		$Errors[] = __('The number of moving average periods must be between 2 and 12');
	}
	if ($Parameters['holdoutmonths'] < 1 or $Parameters['holdoutmonths'] > 12) {
		$Errors[] = __('The hold-out months must be between 1 and 12');
	}
	if ($Parameters['defaulthorizon'] < 1 or $Parameters['defaulthorizon'] > 36) {
		$Errors[] = __('The horizon must be between 1 and 36 months');
	}
	if ($Parameters['percent'] <= -100) {
		$Errors[] = __('The percent over last year must be greater than -100');
	}
	if ($Parameters['linearspan'] < 1 or $Parameters['linearspan'] > 11) {
		$Errors[] = __('The linear approximation span must be between 1 and 11 months');
	}
	if (ForecastParseWeights($Parameters['wmaweights'], 12) === null or count(ForecastParseWeights($Parameters['wmaweights'], 12)) < 2) {
		$Errors[] = __('The weighted moving average weights must be two to twelve percentages separated by commas, most recent period first');
	}
	if (ForecastParseWeights($Parameters['flexweights'], 12) === null) {
		$Errors[] = __('The flexible method weights must be one to twelve percentages separated by commas, most recent period first');
	}
	if ($Parameters['lowaccuracy'] < 0 or $Parameters['lowaccuracy'] > 100) {
		$Errors[] = __('The low accuracy threshold must be between 0 and 100');
	}
	if ($Parameters['variancepct'] < 0) {
		$Errors[] = __('The variance highlight percentage cannot be negative');
	}
	return $Errors;
}

/* Parameters that matter to a method, the ones stored with a forecast so it can be understood later */
function ForecastRelevantParameters($Method, $Parameters) {
	$Keys = array(
		1 => array('percent'),
		2 => array(),
		3 => array(),
		4 => array('maperiods'),
		5 => array('linearspan'),
		6 => array(),
		7 => array(),
		8 => array('flexweights'),
		9 => array('wmaweights'),
		10 => array('alpha'),
		11 => array('alpha', 'beta'),
		12 => array('alpha', 'beta', 'gamma', 'seasonlength'),
	);
	$Relevant = array();
	foreach ($Keys[(int) $Method] as $Key) {
		$Relevant[$Key] = $Parameters[$Key];
	}
	return $Relevant;
}

/* Parameters as stored with a forecast, laid over the defaults */
function ForecastDecodeParameters($Json) {
	$Parameters = ForecastGetParameters();
	$Stored = json_decode($Json, true);
	if (is_array($Stored)) {
		$Parameters = ForecastCleanParameters(array_merge($Parameters, $Stored));
	}
	return $Parameters;
}

function ForecastDescribeParameters($Method, $Json) {
	$Stored = json_decode($Json, true);
	if (!is_array($Stored) or count($Stored) == 0) {
		return '';
	}
	$Parts = array();
	foreach ($Stored as $Key => $Value) {
		$Parts[] = $Key . '=' . $Value;
	}
	return implode(', ', $Parts);
}

/* Months of history a method needs before it will produce a forecast */
function ForecastMinHistory($Method, $Parameters) {
	switch ((int) $Method) {
		case 1:
		case 3:
		case 6:
		case 7:
		case 10:
		case 11:
			return 12;
		case 2:
			return 24;
		case 4:
			return max(4, (int) $Parameters['maperiods']);
		case 5:
			return 6;
		case 8:
			return max(12, count(ForecastParseWeights($Parameters['flexweights']) ?? array()));
		case 9:
			return max(4, count(ForecastParseWeights($Parameters['wmaweights']) ?? array()));
		case 12:
			return max(24, 2 * (int) $Parameters['seasonlength']);
	}
	return PHP_INT_MAX;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   The forecasting methods
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Forecast $Horizon months after the end of $Series with $Method.
   Returns array('ok' => true, 'values' => array(...)) with no negative quantities,
   or array('ok' => false, 'error' => 'reason') - never invented numbers. */
function ForecastCompute($Method, $Series, $Horizon, $Parameters) {
	$Method = (int) $Method;
	$n = count($Series);
	$Horizon = (int) $Horizon;
	$Methods = ForecastMethods();
	if (!isset($Methods[$Method])) {
		return array('ok' => false, 'error' => __('Unknown forecasting method'));
	}
	if ($Horizon < 1) {
		return array('ok' => false, 'error' => __('The horizon must be at least one month'));
	}
	$Required = ForecastMinHistory($Method, $Parameters);
	if ($n < $Required) {
		return array('ok' => false, 'error' => sprintf(__('Insufficient history: %s needs %d months and %d are available'), $Methods[$Method], $Required, $n));
	}

	$Values = array();
	switch ($Method) {
		case 1:
		case 2:
		case 3:
			$Factor = 1;
			if ($Method == 1) {
				$Factor = 1 + ($Parameters['percent'] / 100);
			} elseif ($Method == 2) {
				$LastYear = array_sum(array_slice($Series, $n - 12, 12));
				$YearBefore = array_sum(array_slice($Series, $n - 24, 12));
				if ($YearBefore <= 0) {
					return array('ok' => false, 'error' => __('Sales in the year before last are nil, the growth rate cannot be calculated'));
				}
				$Factor = $LastYear / $YearBefore;
			}
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				// the same calendar month of the most recent twelve months of history
				$Values[] = $Series[$n - 12 + (($h - 1) % 12)] * $Factor;
			}
			break;

		case 4:
			$Last = array_slice($Series, $n - $Parameters['maperiods']);
			$Average = array_sum($Last) / count($Last);
			$Values = array_fill(0, $Horizon, $Average);
			break;

		case 5:
			// the line through the latest month and the month 'span' months before it
			$Span = min($Parameters['linearspan'], $n - 1);
			$Slope = ($Series[$n - 1] - $Series[$n - 1 - $Span]) / $Span;
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$Values[] = $Series[$n - 1] + ($Slope * $h);
			}
			break;

		case 6:
		case 7:
			$Coefficients = ForecastPolynomialFit($Series, $Method == 6 ? 1 : 2);
			if ($Coefficients === null) {
				return array('ok' => false, 'error' => __('The regression could not be solved for this history'));
			}
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$Values[] = ForecastPolynomialValue($Coefficients, $n + $h, $n);
			}
			break;

		case 8:
			// each month is the sum of the preceding months times the weights, forecast months feed later ones
			$Weights = ForecastParseWeights($Parameters['flexweights']);
			$Extended = $Series;
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$Count = count($Extended);
				$Value = 0;
				foreach ($Weights as $Lag => $Weight) {
					$Value += $Weight * $Extended[$Count - 1 - $Lag];
				}
				$Value = max(0, $Value);
				$Extended[] = $Value;
				$Values[] = $Value;
			}
			break;

		case 9:
			$Weights = ForecastParseWeights($Parameters['wmaweights']);
			$Total = 0;
			foreach ($Weights as $Lag => $Weight) {
				$Total += $Weight * $Series[$n - 1 - $Lag];
			}
			$Values = array_fill(0, $Horizon, $Total / array_sum($Weights));
			break;

		case 10:
			$Alpha = $Parameters['alpha'];
			$Level = array_sum(array_slice($Series, 0, 3)) / 3;
			foreach ($Series as $Actual) {
				$Level = ($Alpha * $Actual) + ((1 - $Alpha) * $Level);
			}
			$Values = array_fill(0, $Horizon, $Level);
			break;

		case 11:
			$Alpha = $Parameters['alpha'];
			$Beta = $Parameters['beta'];
			$Level = $Series[0];
			$Trend = ($Series[3] - $Series[0]) / 3;
			for ($t = 1; $t < $n; $t++) {
				$PreviousLevel = $Level;
				$Level = ($Alpha * $Series[$t]) + ((1 - $Alpha) * ($Level + $Trend));
				$Trend = ($Beta * ($Level - $PreviousLevel)) + ((1 - $Beta) * $Trend);
			}
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$Values[] = $Level + ($Trend * $h);
			}
			break;

		case 12:
			// additive Holt-Winters
			$Alpha = $Parameters['alpha'];
			$Beta = $Parameters['beta'];
			$Gamma = $Parameters['gamma'];
			$L = $Parameters['seasonlength'];
			$FirstSeason = array_sum(array_slice($Series, 0, $L)) / $L;
			$SecondSeason = array_sum(array_slice($Series, $L, $L)) / $L;
			$Level = $FirstSeason;
			$Trend = ($SecondSeason - $FirstSeason) / $L;
			$Season = array();
			for ($i = 0; $i < $L; $i++) {
				$Season[$i] = $Series[$i] - $FirstSeason;
			}
			for ($t = $L; $t < $n; $t++) {
				$Index = $t % $L;
				$PreviousLevel = $Level;
				$Level = ($Alpha * ($Series[$t] - $Season[$Index])) + ((1 - $Alpha) * ($Level + $Trend));
				$Trend = ($Beta * ($Level - $PreviousLevel)) + ((1 - $Beta) * $Trend);
				$Season[$Index] = ($Gamma * ($Series[$t] - $Level)) + ((1 - $Gamma) * $Season[$Index]);
			}
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$Values[] = $Level + ($Trend * $h) + $Season[($n - 1 + $h) % $L];
			}
			break;
	}

	foreach ($Values as $Key => $Value) {
		if (!is_finite($Value)) {
			return array('ok' => false, 'error' => __('The calculation did not produce a usable number'));
		}
		$Values[$Key] = round(max(0, $Value), 2);
	}
	return array('ok' => true, 'values' => $Values);
}

/* Least squares polynomial of $Degree (1 or 2) through the series at t = 1..n. Time is centred to keep the
   normal equations well conditioned. Returns the coefficients, lowest power first, or null. */
function ForecastPolynomialFit($Series, $Degree) {
	$n = count($Series);
	$Size = $Degree + 1;
	$Matrix = array();
	for ($r = 0; $r < $Size; $r++) {
		$Matrix[$r] = array_fill(0, $Size + 1, 0.0);
	}
	for ($t = 1; $t <= $n; $t++) {
		$x = $t - (($n + 1) / 2);
		for ($r = 0; $r < $Size; $r++) {
			for ($c = 0; $c < $Size; $c++) {
				$Matrix[$r][$c] += pow($x, $r + $c);
			}
			$Matrix[$r][$Size] += pow($x, $r) * $Series[$t - 1];
		}
	}
	// Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting
	for ($i = 0; $i < $Size; $i++) {
		$Pivot = $i;
		for ($r = $i + 1; $r < $Size; $r++) {
			if (abs($Matrix[$r][$i]) > abs($Matrix[$Pivot][$i])) {
				$Pivot = $r;
			}
		}
		if (abs($Matrix[$Pivot][$i]) < 1e-12) {
			return null;
		}
		$Swap = $Matrix[$i];
		$Matrix[$i] = $Matrix[$Pivot];
		$Matrix[$Pivot] = $Swap;
		for ($r = $i + 1; $r < $Size; $r++) {
			$Ratio = $Matrix[$r][$i] / $Matrix[$i][$i];
			for ($c = $i; $c <= $Size; $c++) {
				$Matrix[$r][$c] -= $Ratio * $Matrix[$i][$c];
			}
		}
	}
	$Coefficients = array_fill(0, $Size, 0.0);
	for ($i = $Size - 1; $i >= 0; $i--) {
		$Sum = $Matrix[$i][$Size];
		for ($c = $i + 1; $c < $Size; $c++) {
			$Sum -= $Matrix[$i][$c] * $Coefficients[$c];
		}
		$Coefficients[$i] = $Sum / $Matrix[$i][$i];
	}
	return $Coefficients;
}

function ForecastPolynomialValue($Coefficients, $t, $n) {
	$x = $t - (($n + 1) / 2);
	$Value = 0;
	foreach ($Coefficients as $Power => $Coefficient) {
		$Value += $Coefficient * pow($x, $Power);
	}
	return $Value;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Accuracy measures
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

function ForecastNewAccumulator() {
	return array('n' => 0, 'sumabs' => 0.0, 'sumsq' => 0.0, 'sumactual' => 0.0, 'sumforecast' => 0.0);
}

function ForecastAccumulate(&$Accumulator, $Actual, $Forecast) {
	$Error = $Actual - $Forecast;
	$Accumulator['n']++;
	$Accumulator['sumabs'] += abs($Error);
	$Accumulator['sumsq'] += $Error * $Error;
	$Accumulator['sumactual'] += $Actual;
	$Accumulator['sumforecast'] += $Forecast;
}

/* MAD, MSE, RMSE and POA from an accumulator.
   POA (percent of accuracy) = 100 x (1 - sum of absolute errors / sum of actual sales), never below 0.
   When there were no actual sales it is 100 if nothing was forecast either, otherwise 0. */
function ForecastMeasures($Accumulator) {
	if ($Accumulator['n'] == 0) {
		return array('n' => 0, 'mad' => null, 'mse' => null, 'rmse' => null, 'poa' => null);
	}
	$Measures = array('n' => $Accumulator['n']);
	$Measures['mad'] = $Accumulator['sumabs'] / $Accumulator['n'];
	$Measures['mse'] = $Accumulator['sumsq'] / $Accumulator['n'];
	$Measures['rmse'] = sqrt($Measures['mse']);
	if ($Accumulator['sumactual'] > 0) {
		$Measures['poa'] = max(0, 100 * (1 - ($Accumulator['sumabs'] / $Accumulator['sumactual'])));
	} else {
		$Measures['poa'] = ($Accumulator['sumabs'] == 0) ? 100 : 0;
	}
	return $Measures;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Best fit: hold out the most recent months, forecast them with each applicable method, compare with what happened
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* One method over the hold-out. Returns null when the method cannot run on the shorter history left for training */
function ForecastBacktest($Method, $Series, $Holdout, $Parameters) {
	$n = count($Series);
	if ($Holdout < 1 or $n - $Holdout < 1) {
		return null;
	}
	$Training = array_slice($Series, 0, $n - $Holdout);
	$Actual = array_slice($Series, $n - $Holdout);
	$Result = ForecastCompute($Method, $Training, $Holdout, $Parameters);
	if (!$Result['ok']) {
		return null;
	}
	$Accumulator = ForecastNewAccumulator();
	foreach ($Actual as $Key => $Value) {
		ForecastAccumulate($Accumulator, $Value, $Result['values'][$Key]);
	}
	return array('accumulator' => $Accumulator, 'measures' => ForecastMeasures($Accumulator), 'forecast' => $Result['values'], 'actual' => $Actual);
}

/* Best method for one series: lowest MAD, then lowest RMSE, then the lower method number.
   Returns array('best' => method or 0, 'results' => method => backtest or null) */
function ForecastBestFitItem($Series, $Parameters, $Holdout, $Methods = null) {
	if ($Methods === null) {
		$Methods = array_keys(ForecastMethods());
	}
	$Results = array();
	$Best = 0;
	foreach ($Methods as $Method) {
		$Results[$Method] = ForecastBacktest($Method, $Series, $Holdout, $Parameters);
		if ($Results[$Method] === null) {
			continue;
		}
		if ($Best == 0) {
			$Best = $Method;
			continue;
		}
		$Mine = $Results[$Method]['measures'];
		$Theirs = $Results[$Best]['measures'];
		if ($Mine['mad'] < $Theirs['mad'] - 1e-9 or (abs($Mine['mad'] - $Theirs['mad']) <= 1e-9 and $Mine['rmse'] < $Theirs['rmse'] - 1e-9)) {
			$Best = $Method;
		}
	}
	return array('best' => $Best, 'results' => $Results);
}

/* Best method across a set of series (a category): the method with the lowest total absolute error as a share of
   total actual sales over the hold-out. Only items that can be tested at all take part, and a method must be
   applicable to every one of them - otherwise methods would be compared on different items. If no method qualifies the
   methods that run on most items are compared. $SeriesList is stockid => series.
   Returns array('best' => method or 0, 'methods' => method => array(items, wape), 'tested' => item count) */
function ForecastBestFitCategory($SeriesList, $Parameters, $Holdout) {
	$Methods = array_keys(ForecastMethods());
	$Totals = array();
	foreach ($Methods as $Method) {
		$Totals[$Method] = array('items' => 0, 'sumabs' => 0.0, 'sumactual' => 0.0);
	}
	$Tested = 0;
	foreach ($SeriesList as $Series) {
		$Any = false;
		foreach ($Methods as $Method) {
			$Backtest = ForecastBacktest($Method, $Series, $Holdout, $Parameters);
			if ($Backtest !== null) {
				$Any = true;
				$Totals[$Method]['items']++;
				$Totals[$Method]['sumabs'] += $Backtest['accumulator']['sumabs'];
				$Totals[$Method]['sumactual'] += $Backtest['accumulator']['sumactual'];
			}
		}
		if ($Any) {
			$Tested++;
		}
	}
	$Candidates = array();
	foreach ($Methods as $Method) {
		if ($Tested > 0 and $Totals[$Method]['items'] == $Tested) {
			$Candidates[] = $Method;
		}
	}
	if (count($Candidates) == 0) {
		$MostItems = 0;
		foreach ($Methods as $Method) {
			$MostItems = max($MostItems, $Totals[$Method]['items']);
		}
		if ($MostItems > 0) {
			foreach ($Methods as $Method) {
				if ($Totals[$Method]['items'] == $MostItems) {
					$Candidates[] = $Method;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	$Best = 0;
	$BestScore = null;
	$Summary = array();
	foreach ($Methods as $Method) {
		$Score = null;
		if ($Totals[$Method]['items'] > 0) {
			$Score = ($Totals[$Method]['sumactual'] > 0) ? $Totals[$Method]['sumabs'] / $Totals[$Method]['sumactual'] : $Totals[$Method]['sumabs'];
		}
		$Summary[$Method] = array('items' => $Totals[$Method]['items'], 'wape' => $Score, 'candidate' => in_array($Method, $Candidates));
		if ($Score !== null and in_array($Method, $Candidates) and ($BestScore === null or $Score < $BestScore - 1e-12)) {
			$Best = $Method;
			$BestScore = $Score;
		}
	}
	return array('best' => $Best, 'methods' => $Summary, 'tested' => $Tested);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Sales history
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Extract the company's sales into monthly buckets for the months from $FromMonth to $ToMonth (both first-of-month
   dates). Sales are the invoiced quantities (stockmoves type 10) less the credited quantities (type 11), the same
   movements Inventory Item Usage reports - open sales orders play no part. Rows for the range are deleted first, so
   running a range again replaces it. Besides item/location the same pass keeps the totals the summary forecasts
   need: by stock category, customer type, sales area and salesperson.
   Returns array('items' => n, 'rows' => n) */
function ForecastExtractHistory($FromMonth, $ToMonth, $UserID) {
	$FromDate = $FromMonth;
	$ToDate = date('Y-m-t', strtotime($ToMonth));
	$MonthExpression = "DATE_FORMAT(stockmoves.trandate, '%Y-%m-01')";
	$Where = "stockmoves.type IN (10, 11)
				AND stockmoves.hidemovt = 0
				AND stockmoves.trandate >= '" . $FromDate . "'
				AND stockmoves.trandate <= '" . $ToDate . "'";

	DB_Txn_Begin();
	DB_query("DELETE FROM forecasthistory WHERE periodstart >= '" . $FromMonth . "' AND periodstart <= '" . $ToMonth . "'", '', '', true);
	DB_query("DELETE FROM forecasthistorydim WHERE periodstart >= '" . $FromMonth . "' AND periodstart <= '" . $ToMonth . "'", '', '', true);

	DB_query("INSERT INTO forecasthistory (stockid, loccode, periodstart, quantity)
				SELECT stockmoves.stockid,
						stockmoves.loccode,
						" . $MonthExpression . ",
						ROUND(SUM(-stockmoves.qty), 4)
				FROM stockmoves
				WHERE " . $Where . "
				GROUP BY stockmoves.stockid, stockmoves.loccode, " . $MonthExpression . "
				HAVING ROUND(SUM(-stockmoves.qty), 4) <> 0", '', '', true);

	$Dimensions = array(
		'category' => array("stockmaster.categoryid", "INNER JOIN stockmaster ON stockmaster.stockid = stockmoves.stockid"),
		'custtype' => array("COALESCE(CAST(debtorsmaster.typeid AS CHAR), '')", "LEFT JOIN debtorsmaster ON debtorsmaster.debtorno = stockmoves.debtorno"),
		'area' => array("COALESCE(custbranch.area, '')", "LEFT JOIN custbranch ON custbranch.debtorno = stockmoves.debtorno AND custbranch.branchcode = stockmoves.branchcode"),
		'salesman' => array("COALESCE(custbranch.salesman, '')", "LEFT JOIN custbranch ON custbranch.debtorno = stockmoves.debtorno AND custbranch.branchcode = stockmoves.branchcode"),
	);
	foreach ($Dimensions as $DimType => $Definition) {
		DB_query("INSERT INTO forecasthistorydim (dimtype, dimkey, periodstart, quantity)
					SELECT '" . $DimType . "',
							" . $Definition[0] . ",
							" . $MonthExpression . ",
							ROUND(SUM(-stockmoves.qty), 4)
					FROM stockmoves
					" . $Definition[1] . "
					WHERE " . $Where . "
					GROUP BY " . $Definition[0] . ", " . $MonthExpression . "
					HAVING ROUND(SUM(-stockmoves.qty), 4) <> 0", '', '', true);
	}

	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stockid), COUNT(*)
						FROM forecasthistory
						WHERE periodstart >= '" . $FromMonth . "' AND periodstart <= '" . $ToMonth . "'", '', '', true);
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	DB_query("INSERT INTO forecasthistoryruns (fromperiod, toperiod, runby, rundate, itemcount, rowcount)
				VALUES ('" . $FromMonth . "', '" . $ToMonth . "', '" . DB_escape_string($UserID) . "', '" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "', " . (int) $MyRow[0] . ", " . (int) $MyRow[1] . ")", '', '', true);
	DB_Txn_Commit();

	return array('items' => (int) $MyRow[0], 'rows' => (int) $MyRow[1]);
}

/* What history is held: first and last month extracted, number of items and months with sales, and whether the
   extractions leave a gap (months nobody extracted count as no sales). */
function ForecastHistoryBounds() {
	$Bounds = array('from' => null, 'to' => null, 'items' => 0, 'months' => 0, 'rows' => 0, 'gaps' => false, 'lastrun' => null);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT fromperiod, toperiod, runby, rundate FROM forecasthistoryruns ORDER BY fromperiod, toperiod");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return $Bounds;
	}
	$CoveredTo = null;
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		if ($Bounds['from'] === null or $MyRow['fromperiod'] < $Bounds['from']) {
			$Bounds['from'] = $MyRow['fromperiod'];
		}
		if ($Bounds['to'] === null or $MyRow['toperiod'] > $Bounds['to']) {
			$Bounds['to'] = $MyRow['toperiod'];
		}
		if ($CoveredTo !== null and $MyRow['fromperiod'] > ForecastAddMonths($CoveredTo, 1)) {
			$Bounds['gaps'] = true;
		}
		if ($CoveredTo === null or $MyRow['toperiod'] > $CoveredTo) {
			$CoveredTo = $MyRow['toperiod'];
		}
		if ($Bounds['lastrun'] === null or $MyRow['rundate'] > $Bounds['lastrun']['rundate']) {
			$Bounds['lastrun'] = $MyRow;
		}
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stockid), COUNT(DISTINCT periodstart), COUNT(*) FROM forecasthistory");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Bounds['items'] = (int) $MyRow[0];
	$Bounds['months'] = (int) $MyRow[1];
	$Bounds['rows'] = (int) $MyRow[2];
	return $Bounds;
}

/* The monthly series of an item (all locations when $LocCode is '') from its first month with sales to the end of
   the history held. Months in between without sales are zero. Returns array('start' => Y-m-01, 'values' => array()) */
function ForecastItemSeries($StockID, $LocCode, $HistoryEnd) {
	$SQL = "SELECT periodstart, SUM(quantity) AS quantity
			FROM forecasthistory
			WHERE stockid = '" . DB_escape_string($StockID) . "'" .
			($LocCode != '' ? " AND loccode = '" . DB_escape_string($LocCode) . "'" : '') . "
				AND periodstart <= '" . $HistoryEnd . "'
			GROUP BY periodstart
			ORDER BY periodstart";
	return ForecastSeriesFromResult(DB_query($SQL), $HistoryEnd);
}

function ForecastDimensionSeries($DimType, $DimKey, $HistoryEnd) {
	$SQL = "SELECT periodstart, quantity
			FROM forecasthistorydim
			WHERE dimtype = '" . DB_escape_string($DimType) . "'
				AND dimkey = '" . DB_escape_string($DimKey) . "'
				AND periodstart <= '" . $HistoryEnd . "'
			ORDER BY periodstart";
	return ForecastSeriesFromResult(DB_query($SQL), $HistoryEnd);
}

function ForecastSeriesFromResult($Result, $HistoryEnd) {
	$Rows = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Rows[$MyRow['periodstart']] = (float) $MyRow['quantity'];
	}
	if (count($Rows) == 0) {
		return array('start' => '', 'values' => array());
	}
	$Start = array_key_first($Rows);
	$Months = ForecastMonthsBetween($Start, $HistoryEnd);
	$Values = array();
	for ($i = 0; $i < $Months; $i++) {
		$Period = ForecastAddMonths($Start, $i);
		$Values[] = $Rows[$Period] ?? 0.0;
	}
	return array('start' => $Start, 'values' => $Values);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Item forecasts
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* SQL for the quantity MRP, reports and accuracy use: the revised quantity when there is one */
function ForecastEffectiveSQL($Alias = 'forecastdetails') {
	return "COALESCE(" . $Alias . ".revisedqty, " . $Alias . ".calcqty)";
}

/* Store a forecast as the active one for the item and location. The one it replaces is kept, no longer active. */
function ForecastStore($StockID, $LocCode, $Method, $Parameters, $Horizon, $HistoryEnd, $Values, $UserID, $BatchID, $Notes) {
	$FirstPeriod = ForecastAddMonths($HistoryEnd, 1);
	$StockID = DB_escape_string($StockID);
	$LocCode = DB_escape_string($LocCode);
	DB_Txn_Begin();
	DB_query("UPDATE forecasts SET isactive = NULL
				WHERE stockid = '" . $StockID . "' AND loccode = '" . $LocCode . "' AND isactive = 1", '', '', true);
	DB_query("INSERT INTO forecasts (stockid, loccode, method, params, horizon, historyend, firstperiod, createdby, createdate, isactive, batchid, notes)
				VALUES ('" . $StockID . "',
						'" . $LocCode . "',
						" . (int) $Method . ",
						'" . DB_escape_string(json_encode(ForecastRelevantParameters($Method, $Parameters))) . "',
						" . (int) $Horizon . ",
						'" . $HistoryEnd . "',
						'" . $FirstPeriod . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($UserID) . "',
						'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
						1,
						" . (int) $BatchID . ",
						'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Notes, 0, 255)) . "')", '', '', true);
	$ForecastID = (int) DB_Last_Insert_ID('forecasts', 'forecastid');
	$Rows = array();
	foreach ($Values as $Key => $Value) {
		$Rows[] = "(" . $ForecastID . ", '" . ForecastAddMonths($FirstPeriod, $Key) . "', " . (float) $Value . ")";
	}
	DB_query("INSERT INTO forecastdetails (forecastid, periodstart, calcqty) VALUES " . implode(', ', $Rows), '', '', true);
	DB_Txn_Commit();
	return $ForecastID;
}

/* Forecast one item and location. $Method 0 asks for the best fit.
   Returns array('ok' => bool, 'message' => text, 'forecastid' => id, 'method' => method used) */
function ForecastGenerateItem($StockID, $LocCode, $Method, $Horizon, $Parameters, $UserID, $BatchID = 0) {
	$Bounds = ForecastHistoryBounds();
	if ($Bounds['to'] === null) {
		return array('ok' => false, 'message' => __('No sales history has been extracted yet'), 'forecastid' => 0, 'method' => 0);
	}
	$Series = ForecastItemSeries($StockID, $LocCode, $Bounds['to']);
	if (count($Series['values']) == 0) {
		return array('ok' => false, 'message' => __('No sales history for this item') . ($LocCode != '' ? ' ' . __('at this location') : ''), 'forecastid' => 0, 'method' => 0);
	}
	$Notes = '';
	if ($Method == 0) {
		$Fit = ForecastBestFitItem($Series['values'], $Parameters, $Parameters['holdoutmonths']);
		if ($Fit['best'] == 0) {
			return array('ok' => false, 'message' => sprintf(__('Insufficient history for the best fit comparison: %d months available, a %d month hold-out leaves too little to train any method'), count($Series['values']), $Parameters['holdoutmonths']), 'forecastid' => 0, 'method' => 0);
		}
		$Method = $Fit['best'];
		$Notes = sprintf(__('Best fit over a %d month hold-out: %s, MAD %s'), $Parameters['holdoutmonths'], ForecastMethodName($Method), round($Fit['results'][$Method]['measures']['mad'], 2));
	}
	return ForecastGenerateWithMethod($StockID, $LocCode, $Method, $Series, $Bounds['to'], $Horizon, $Parameters, $UserID, $BatchID, $Notes);
}

function ForecastGenerateWithMethod($StockID, $LocCode, $Method, $Series, $HistoryEnd, $Horizon, $Parameters, $UserID, $BatchID, $Notes) {
	$Result = ForecastCompute($Method, $Series['values'], $Horizon, $Parameters);
	if (!$Result['ok']) {
		return array('ok' => false, 'message' => $Result['error'], 'forecastid' => 0, 'method' => $Method);
	}
	$ForecastID = ForecastStore($StockID, $LocCode, $Method, $Parameters, $Horizon, $HistoryEnd, $Result['values'], $UserID, $BatchID, $Notes);
	return array('ok' => true, 'message' => '', 'forecastid' => $ForecastID, 'method' => $Method);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Batches: a single item or a whole category, worked through a few items at a time so large categories do not time out
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* The active items of a category: not discontinued and not dummy (service) items */
function ForecastCategoryItems($CategoryID) {
	$Items = array();
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT stockid FROM stockmaster
						WHERE categoryid = '" . DB_escape_string($CategoryID) . "'
							AND discontinued = 0
							AND mbflag <> 'D'
						ORDER BY stockid");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow[0];
	}
	return $Items;
}

/* Start a batch. $ScopeType is 'item' or 'category'. Returns the batch id. For the best fit on a category the
   method recommended for the category is worked out here, once, and used for every item. */
function ForecastCreateBatch($ScopeType, $StockID, $CategoryID, $LocCode, $Method, $Horizon, $Parameters, $UserID) {
	$Items = ($ScopeType == 'item') ? array($StockID) : ForecastCategoryItems($CategoryID);
	$ChosenMethod = $Method;
	$Notes = '';
	if ($ScopeType == 'category' and $Method == 0) {
		$Bounds = ForecastHistoryBounds();
		$SeriesList = array();
		if ($Bounds['to'] !== null) {
			foreach ($Items as $Item) {
				$Series = ForecastItemSeries($Item, $LocCode, $Bounds['to']);
				if (count($Series['values']) > 0) {
					$SeriesList[$Item] = $Series['values'];
				}
			}
		}
		$Fit = ForecastBestFitCategory($SeriesList, $Parameters, $Parameters['holdoutmonths']);
		$ChosenMethod = $Fit['best'];
		if ($ChosenMethod > 0) {
			$Notes = sprintf(__('Best fit for the category over a %d month hold-out, %d items compared: %s'), $Parameters['holdoutmonths'], $Fit['tested'], ForecastMethodName($ChosenMethod));
		} else {
			$Notes = __('No method could be compared on this category, the history is too short');
		}
	}
	DB_query("INSERT INTO forecastbatches (scopetype, stockid, categoryid, loccode, method, chosenmethod, horizon, params, createdby, createdate, status, totalitems, notes)
				VALUES ('" . $ScopeType . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($StockID) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($CategoryID) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($LocCode) . "',
						" . (int) $Method . ",
						" . (int) $ChosenMethod . ",
						" . (int) $Horizon . ",
						'" . DB_escape_string(json_encode($Parameters)) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($UserID) . "',
						'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
						'" . (count($Items) > 0 ? 'running' : 'complete') . "',
						" . count($Items) . ",
						'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Notes, 0, 255)) . "')");
	$BatchID = (int) DB_Last_Insert_ID('forecastbatches', 'batchid');
	foreach (array_chunk($Items, 200) as $Chunk) {
		$Rows = array();
		foreach ($Chunk as $Item) {
			$Rows[] = "(" . $BatchID . ", '" . DB_escape_string($Item) . "', 'pending')";
		}
		DB_query("INSERT INTO forecastbatchresults (batchid, stockid, status) VALUES " . implode(', ', $Rows));
	}
	return $BatchID;
}

/* Forecast the next $Limit pending items of a batch and record each outcome. */
function ForecastProcessBatch($BatchID, $Limit) {
	$BatchResult = DB_query("SELECT * FROM forecastbatches WHERE batchid = " . (int) $BatchID);
	$Batch = DB_fetch_array($BatchResult);
	if (!$Batch or $Batch['status'] == 'complete') {
		return;
	}
	$Parameters = ForecastCleanParameters(array_merge(ForecastDefaultParameters(), json_decode($Batch['params'], true) ?: array()));
	$Method = ($Batch['method'] == 0) ? (int) $Batch['chosenmethod'] : (int) $Batch['method'];

	$Pending = DB_query("SELECT stockid FROM forecastbatchresults
						WHERE batchid = " . (int) $BatchID . " AND status = 'pending'
						ORDER BY stockid LIMIT " . (int) $Limit);
	while ($Item = DB_fetch_array($Pending)) {
		if ($Method == 0) {
			$Outcome = array('ok' => false, 'message' => __('No forecasting method could be chosen for this category, the history is too short'), 'forecastid' => 0);
		} else {
			$Bounds = ForecastHistoryBounds();
			$Series = $Bounds['to'] === null ? array('values' => array()) : ForecastItemSeries($Item['stockid'], $Batch['loccode'], $Bounds['to']);
			if (count($Series['values']) == 0) {
				$Outcome = array('ok' => false, 'message' => __('No sales history for this item') . ($Batch['loccode'] != '' ? ' ' . __('at this location') : ''), 'forecastid' => 0);
			} else {
				$Notes = ($Batch['method'] == 0) ? $Batch['notes'] : '';
				$Outcome = ForecastGenerateWithMethod($Item['stockid'], $Batch['loccode'], $Method, $Series, $Bounds['to'], $Batch['horizon'], $Parameters, $Batch['createdby'], $BatchID, $Notes);
			}
		}
		DB_query("UPDATE forecastbatchresults
					SET status = '" . ($Outcome['ok'] ? 'ok' : 'failed') . "',
						message = '" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Outcome['message'], 0, 255)) . "',
						forecastid = " . (int) $Outcome['forecastid'] . "
					WHERE batchid = " . (int) $BatchID . " AND stockid = '" . DB_escape_string($Item['stockid']) . "'");
	}

	$Counts = DB_query("SELECT SUM(status = 'ok'), SUM(status = 'failed'), SUM(status = 'pending')
						FROM forecastbatchresults WHERE batchid = " . (int) $BatchID);
	$CountRow = DB_fetch_row($Counts);
	DB_query("UPDATE forecastbatches
				SET successcount = " . (int) $CountRow[0] . ",
					failcount = " . (int) $CountRow[1] . ",
					status = '" . ((int) $CountRow[2] == 0 ? 'complete' : 'running') . "'
				WHERE batchid = " . (int) $BatchID);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Summary forecasts (stock category, customer type, sales area, salesperson)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

function ForecastDimensionTypes() {
	return array(
		'category' => __('Stock category'),
		'custtype' => __('Customer type'),
		'area' => __('Sales area'),
		'salesman' => __('Salesperson'),
	);
}

/* The keys of a dimension that have history, with a readable name: key => name */
function ForecastDimensionKeys($DimType) {
	switch ($DimType) {
		case 'category':
			$Name = "(SELECT categorydescription FROM stockcategory WHERE categoryid = forecasthistorydim.dimkey)";
			break;
		case 'custtype':
			$Name = "(SELECT typename FROM debtortype WHERE typeid = forecasthistorydim.dimkey)";
			break;
		case 'area':
			$Name = "(SELECT areadescription FROM areas WHERE areacode = forecasthistorydim.dimkey)";
			break;
		default:
			$Name = "(SELECT salesmanname FROM salesman WHERE salesmancode = forecasthistorydim.dimkey)";
	}
	$Keys = array();
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT DISTINCT dimkey, " . $Name . " AS name
						FROM forecasthistorydim
						WHERE dimtype = '" . DB_escape_string($DimType) . "'
						ORDER BY dimkey");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Keys[$MyRow['dimkey']] = ($MyRow['dimkey'] === '' ? __('Unassigned') : ($MyRow['name'] ?? $MyRow['dimkey']));
	}
	return $Keys;
}

/* Summary forecast for one dimension key, stored as the active summary of that key (the previous one is kept, no
   longer active). Returns the same shape as ForecastGenerateItem with 'summaryid'. */
function ForecastGenerateSummary($DimType, $DimKey, $Method, $Horizon, $Parameters, $UserID) {
	$Bounds = ForecastHistoryBounds();
	if ($Bounds['to'] === null) {
		return array('ok' => false, 'message' => __('No sales history has been extracted yet'), 'summaryid' => 0, 'method' => 0);
	}
	$Series = ForecastDimensionSeries($DimType, $DimKey, $Bounds['to']);
	if (count($Series['values']) == 0) {
		return array('ok' => false, 'message' => __('No sales history'), 'summaryid' => 0, 'method' => 0);
	}
	$Notes = '';
	if ($Method == 0) {
		$Fit = ForecastBestFitItem($Series['values'], $Parameters, $Parameters['holdoutmonths']);
		if ($Fit['best'] == 0) {
			return array('ok' => false, 'message' => sprintf(__('Insufficient history for the best fit comparison: %d months available, a %d month hold-out leaves too little to train any method'), count($Series['values']), $Parameters['holdoutmonths']), 'summaryid' => 0, 'method' => 0);
		}
		$Method = $Fit['best'];
		$Notes = sprintf(__('Best fit over a %d month hold-out: %s, MAD %s'), $Parameters['holdoutmonths'], ForecastMethodName($Method), round($Fit['results'][$Method]['measures']['mad'], 2));
	}
	$Result = ForecastCompute($Method, $Series['values'], $Horizon, $Parameters);
	if (!$Result['ok']) {
		return array('ok' => false, 'message' => $Result['error'], 'summaryid' => 0, 'method' => $Method);
	}
	$FirstPeriod = ForecastAddMonths($Bounds['to'], 1);
	DB_Txn_Begin();
	DB_query("UPDATE forecastsummaries SET isactive = NULL
				WHERE dimtype = '" . DB_escape_string($DimType) . "' AND dimkey = '" . DB_escape_string($DimKey) . "' AND isactive = 1", '', '', true);
	DB_query("INSERT INTO forecastsummaries (dimtype, dimkey, method, params, horizon, historyend, firstperiod, createdby, createdate, isactive, notes)
				VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DimType) . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($DimKey) . "',
						" . (int) $Method . ",
						'" . DB_escape_string(json_encode(ForecastRelevantParameters($Method, $Parameters))) . "',
						" . (int) $Horizon . ",
						'" . $Bounds['to'] . "',
						'" . $FirstPeriod . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($UserID) . "',
						'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
						1,
						'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Notes, 0, 255)) . "')", '', '', true);
	$SummaryID = (int) DB_Last_Insert_ID('forecastsummaries', 'summaryid');
	$Rows = array();
	foreach ($Result['values'] as $Key => $Value) {
		$Rows[] = "(" . $SummaryID . ", '" . ForecastAddMonths($FirstPeriod, $Key) . "', " . (float) $Value . ")";
	}
	DB_query("INSERT INTO forecastsummarydetails (summaryid, periodstart, calcqty) VALUES " . implode(', ', $Rows), '', '', true);
	DB_Txn_Commit();
	return array('ok' => true, 'message' => '', 'summaryid' => $SummaryID, 'method' => $Method);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Review helpers
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Actual sales of the same months a year earlier: periodstart => quantity, or null when that month is outside the
   history held. $Source is array('item', stockid, loccode) or array('dim', dimtype, dimkey). */
function ForecastLastYear($Source, $Periods, $Bounds) {
	$Actuals = array();
	if (count($Periods) == 0) {
		return $Actuals;
	}
	$Earlier = array();
	foreach ($Periods as $Period) {
		$Earlier[$Period] = ForecastAddMonths($Period, -12);
	}
	if ($Source[0] == 'item') {
		$SQL = "SELECT periodstart, SUM(quantity) AS quantity FROM forecasthistory
				WHERE stockid = '" . DB_escape_string($Source[1]) . "'" .
				($Source[2] != '' ? " AND loccode = '" . DB_escape_string($Source[2]) . "'" : '') . "
					AND periodstart IN ('" . implode("','", $Earlier) . "')
				GROUP BY periodstart";
	} else {
		$SQL = "SELECT periodstart, quantity FROM forecasthistorydim
				WHERE dimtype = '" . DB_escape_string($Source[1]) . "' AND dimkey = '" . DB_escape_string($Source[2]) . "'
					AND periodstart IN ('" . implode("','", $Earlier) . "')";
	}
	$Held = array();
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Held[$MyRow['periodstart']] = (float) $MyRow['quantity'];
	}
	foreach ($Earlier as $Period => $LastYearPeriod) {
		if ($Bounds['from'] !== null and $LastYearPeriod >= $Bounds['from'] and $LastYearPeriod <= $Bounds['to']) {
			$Actuals[$Period] = $Held[$LastYearPeriod] ?? 0.0;
		} else {
			$Actuals[$Period] = null;
		}
	}
	return $Actuals;
}

/* Is the variance of a forecast against last year large? */
function ForecastLargeVariance($Quantity, $LastYear, $ThresholdPercent) {
	if ($LastYear === null) {
		return false;
	}
	if ($LastYear == 0) {
		return $Quantity > 0;
	}
	return abs(($Quantity - $LastYear) / $LastYear * 100) >= $ThresholdPercent;
}

/* Read the revised quantities posted from a review form. Returns array(period => float or null, errors). A blank
   field clears the revision, so the calculated quantity applies again. */
function ForecastReadRevisions($Posted, $Periods) {
	$Revisions = array();
	$Errors = array();
	foreach ($Periods as $Period) {
		$Value = trim($Posted[$Period] ?? '');
		if ($Value === '') {
			$Revisions[$Period] = null;
			continue;
		}
		$Number = filter_number_format($Value);
		if (!is_numeric($Number) or $Number < 0) {
			$Errors[] = ForecastMonthLabel($Period) . ': ' . __('the revised quantity must be a number that is not negative, or blank to use the calculated quantity');
			continue;
		}
		$Revisions[$Period] = (float) $Number;
	}
	return array($Revisions, $Errors);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Converting forecasts into MRP demands
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* The quantities MRP should plan for an item: period => quantity (effective, revised first).
   An item forecast over all locations is used on its own; otherwise the per-location active forecasts are added up,
   so nothing is counted twice. */
function ForecastItemDemandByPeriod($StockID) {
	$StockID = DB_escape_string($StockID);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT forecastid FROM forecasts WHERE stockid = '" . $StockID . "' AND loccode = '' AND isactive = 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) > 0) {
		$Where = "forecasts.loccode = ''";
	} else {
		$Where = "forecasts.loccode <> ''";
	}
	$Quantities = array();
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT forecastdetails.periodstart, SUM(" . ForecastEffectiveSQL() . ") AS quantity
						FROM forecasts
						INNER JOIN forecastdetails ON forecastdetails.forecastid = forecasts.forecastid
						WHERE forecasts.stockid = '" . $StockID . "'
							AND forecasts.isactive = 1
							AND " . $Where . "
						GROUP BY forecastdetails.periodstart
						ORDER BY forecastdetails.periodstart");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Quantities[$MyRow['periodstart']] = (float) $MyRow['quantity'];
	}
	return $Quantities;
}

/* Write the active forecasts of $Items as MRP demands of type FC for the months that overlap $FromDate..$ToDate.
   The demands written are recorded in forecastmrpdemands, so replace mode removes exactly those and no demand entered
   by hand or from another source is ever touched. 'replace' removes the recorded forecast demands of the items for the
   horizon first; 'incremental' only adds months an item has no recorded forecast demand for. Run twice, the result is
   the same. Returns array('items', 'deleted', 'inserted', 'skipped'). */
function ForecastConvertToMRP($Items, $FromDate, $ToDate, $Mode, $UserID) {
	$FirstMonth = ForecastMonthStart($FromDate);
	$Counts = array('items' => 0, 'deleted' => 0, 'inserted' => 0, 'skipped' => 0);
	DB_Txn_Begin();
	foreach ($Items as $StockID) {
		$Quantities = ForecastItemDemandByPeriod($StockID);
		$Escaped = DB_escape_string($StockID);
		$Counts['items']++;

		if ($Mode == 'replace') {
			$Result = DB_query("SELECT forecastmrpdemands.demandid
								FROM forecastmrpdemands
								INNER JOIN mrpdemands ON mrpdemands.demandid = forecastmrpdemands.demandid
								WHERE forecastmrpdemands.stockid = '" . $Escaped . "'
									AND mrpdemands.mrpdemandtype = '" . FORECAST_DEMAND_TYPE . "'
									AND forecastmrpdemands.periodstart >= '" . $FirstMonth . "'
									AND forecastmrpdemands.periodstart <= '" . $ToDate . "'", '', '', true);
			$DemandIDs = array();
			while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
				$DemandIDs[] = (int) $MyRow[0];
			}
			if (count($DemandIDs) > 0) {
				DB_query("DELETE FROM mrpdemands WHERE demandid IN (" . implode(',', $DemandIDs) . ") AND mrpdemandtype = '" . FORECAST_DEMAND_TYPE . "'", '', '', true);
				DB_query("DELETE FROM forecastmrpdemands WHERE demandid IN (" . implode(',', $DemandIDs) . ")", '', '', true);
				$Counts['deleted'] += count($DemandIDs);
			}
		}

		foreach ($Quantities as $Period => $Quantity) {
			// the month must overlap the horizon, and there is nothing to plan for a zero quantity
			if ($Period < $FirstMonth or $Period > $ToDate or $Quantity <= 0) {
				continue;
			}
			if ($Mode != 'replace') {
				$Result = DB_query("SELECT forecastmrpdemands.demandid
									FROM forecastmrpdemands
									INNER JOIN mrpdemands ON mrpdemands.demandid = forecastmrpdemands.demandid
									WHERE forecastmrpdemands.stockid = '" . $Escaped . "'
										AND forecastmrpdemands.periodstart = '" . $Period . "'
										AND mrpdemands.mrpdemandtype = '" . FORECAST_DEMAND_TYPE . "'", '', '', true);
				if (DB_num_rows($Result) > 0) {
					$Counts['skipped']++;
					continue;
				}
			}
			// a month that has already started is planned from the first day of the horizon
			$DueDate = max($Period, ForecastMonthStart($FromDate) == $Period ? $FromDate : $Period);
			DB_query("INSERT INTO mrpdemands (stockid, mrpdemandtype, quantity, duedate)
						VALUES ('" . $Escaped . "', '" . FORECAST_DEMAND_TYPE . "', " . $Quantity . ", '" . $DueDate . "')", '', '', true);
			$DemandID = (int) DB_Last_Insert_ID('mrpdemands', 'demandid');
			DB_query("INSERT INTO forecastmrpdemands (demandid, stockid, periodstart, forecastid, convertedby, convertdate)
						VALUES (" . $DemandID . ", '" . $Escaped . "', '" . $Period . "', 0, '" . DB_escape_string($UserID) . "', '" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "')", '', '', true);
			$Counts['inserted']++;
		}
	}
	DB_Txn_Commit();
	return $Counts;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Form pieces shared by several pages
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

function ForecastCategoryOptions($Selected = '', $AllLabel = '') {
	$Options = '';
	if ($AllLabel != '') {
		$Options .= '<option value="">' . $AllLabel . '</option>';
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT categoryid, categorydescription FROM stockcategory ORDER BY categorydescription");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Options .= '<option value="' . htmlspecialchars($MyRow['categoryid'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '"' . ($MyRow['categoryid'] === $Selected ? ' selected="selected"' : '') . '>' . htmlspecialchars($MyRow['categoryid'] . ' - ' . $MyRow['categorydescription'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '</option>';
	}
	return $Options;
}

function ForecastLocationOptions($Selected = '', $AllLabel = '') {
	$Options = '<option value="">' . $AllLabel . '</option>';
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT locations.loccode, locations.locationname
						FROM locations
						INNER JOIN locationusers ON locationusers.loccode = locations.loccode
							AND locationusers.userid = '" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['UserID']) . "'
							AND locationusers.canview = 1
						ORDER BY locations.locationname");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Options .= '<option value="' . htmlspecialchars($MyRow['loccode'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '"' . ($MyRow['loccode'] === $Selected ? ' selected="selected"' : '') . '>' . htmlspecialchars($MyRow['locationname'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '</option>';
	}
	return $Options;
}

function ForecastMethodOptions($Selected = 0, $BestFitLabel = '') {
	$Options = '';
	if ($BestFitLabel != '') {
		$Options .= '<option value="0"' . ($Selected == 0 ? ' selected="selected"' : '') . '>' . $BestFitLabel . '</option>';
	}
	foreach (ForecastMethods() as $Number => $Name) {
		$Options .= '<option value="' . $Number . '"' . ($Number == $Selected ? ' selected="selected"' : '') . '>' . $Number . ' - ' . htmlspecialchars($Name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '</option>';
	}
	return $Options;
}

/* The method parameter inputs, filled from $Values (the company defaults unless the user changed them) */
function ForecastParameterFields($Values) {
	$Fields = array(
		array('percent', __('Percent over last year (method 1)'), 'number', 'step="0.01"'),
		array('maperiods', __('Moving average periods (method 4)'), 'number', 'min="2" max="12" step="1"'),
		array('linearspan', __('Linear approximation span in months (method 5)'), 'number', 'min="1" max="11" step="1"'),
		array('flexweights', __('Flexible method weights, % per prior period, most recent first (method 8)'), 'text', 'size="35"'),
		array('wmaweights', __('Weighted moving average weights, %, most recent first (method 9)'), 'text', 'size="35"'),
		array('alpha', __('Alpha (methods 10 to 12)'), 'number', 'min="0.1" max="0.9" step="0.01"'),
		array('beta', __('Beta (methods 11 and 12)'), 'number', 'min="0.01" max="0.99" step="0.01"'),
		array('gamma', __('Gamma (method 12)'), 'number', 'min="0.01" max="0.99" step="0.01"'),
		array('seasonlength', __('Season length in months (method 12)'), 'number', 'min="2" max="12" step="1"'),
		array('holdoutmonths', __('Hold-out months for the best fit'), 'number', 'min="1" max="12" step="1"'),
	);
	$Html = '';
	foreach ($Fields as $Field) {
		$Html .= '<field>
				<label for="' . $Field[0] . '">' . $Field[1] . ':</label>
				<input type="' . $Field[2] . '" name="' . $Field[0] . '" id="' . $Field[0] . '" ' . $Field[3] . ' value="' . htmlspecialchars($Values[$Field[0]], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '" />
			</field>';
	}
	return $Html;
}

/* Parameters as posted by ForecastParameterFields(), over the company defaults for anything missing */
function ForecastReadParameters($Posted) {
	$Parameters = ForecastGetParameters();
	foreach (array('percent', 'maperiods', 'linearspan', 'flexweights', 'wmaweights', 'alpha', 'beta', 'gamma', 'seasonlength', 'holdoutmonths', 'defaulthorizon', 'lowaccuracy', 'variancepct') as $Key) {
		if (isset($Posted[$Key]) and trim($Posted[$Key]) !== '') {
			$Parameters[$Key] = ForecastInput($Posted[$Key]);
		}
	}
	return ForecastCleanParameters($Parameters);
}

function ForecastPageTitle($Title) {
	global $RootPath, $Theme;
	echo '<p class="page_title_text"><img src="' . $RootPath . '/css/' . $Theme . '/images/inventory.png" title="' . $Title . '" alt="" />' . ' ' . $Title . '</p>';
}

function ForecastNoHistoryNotice() {
	global $RootPath;
	prnMsg(__('No sales history has been extracted yet.') . ' <a href="' . $RootPath . '/ForecastHistory.php">' . __('Extract sales history') . '</a>', 'warn');
}

function ForecastFormatQuantity($Value) {
	return locale_number_format($Value, 2);
}
